
```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(exactextractr)
# library(jsonlite)
# library(stringr)   
library(ggplot2)
library(munsell)
library(mapview)
```

```{r}    
source(here::here("inc/landcover-functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load data
slc_code <- as.numeric(params$cellcode)
raster_file <- sprintf("gisdata/landcover/lc-cell-id-%s.tif", slc_code)
r0 <- rast(here::here(raster_file))
names(r0) <- 1988:2024
here::i_am("indicator/download.qmd")
slc_aoo <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM_AOO.gpkg"),
    quiet = TRUE) |> 
    st_transform(st_crs(r0)) |>
    slice(slc_code)
slc_imap <- st_read(
    here::here("gisdata/TEC/Swamps-Fleurieu-IM.gpkg"),
    quiet = TRUE) |> 
    st_transform(st_crs(r0)) |>
    st_crop(slc_aoo)
```

Here we focus on this region of the Fleurieu Peninsula:
```{r}
#| label: map of the cell
mapview(slc_aoo) + mapview(slc_imap) + mapview(r0, hide=TRUE)
```
